messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance window for hosted inference — 2026-04-02 02:00-03:30 UTC. Affected: Redwood API (text generation + embeddings) in us-west-2 and eu-west-1. Planned action: kernel/driver upgrade + runtime pin to v2.3.1 for a safety rollback path.

Maya (prodops): Heads-up for comms: we need a short statuspage snippet + customer email copy. Can we get the exact impact wording? Will calls fail or return degraded perf?

Lex (eng-oncall): TL;DR: requests will 503 briefly during node drain for ~30s per instance; we have rolling drains to avoid full-region outage. During the 02:30-02:50 UTC canary window we'll pin traffic to legacy runtime v2.2.x for tiered customers if we see >1% error spike. Otherwise we proceed and unpin after verification.

Alec (support): OK. I can draft the statuspage + canned CS answers. Need final ETA for post-maint smoke and expected SLA impact (if any). Also pls include instructions for customers on dedicated (they're unaffected unless on our managed autoscaler).

Hana (sre): Add: autoscaling will be paused for the window to avoid churn. No config changes required for dedicated/private deploys. We'll enable a degraded-mode fallback to model-variant small-quantized for low-tier plans in us-west-2 only if latency >150ms  p95 for >10 minutes.

Maya (prodops): Great — here's a compact statuspage snippet to use (feel free to tweak):

```
Scheduled maintenance: Kernel/Runtime upgrades affecting hosted API in us-west-2 & eu-west-1.
Start: 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC — End: 2026-04-02 03:30 UTC (approx).
Impact: Short, rolling 503s during node drains; degraded latency possible for a subset of requests.
Customer action: None required. Dedicated/private deployments not impacted.
```

Maya (prodops): And a short email subject + body we can send to customers: 

Subject: Planned maintenance — brief impact to hosted API (Apr 2)

Body: Hi — We will perform a scheduled maintenance on Apr 2 that may cause brief request failures or higher latency for hosted API users in US-WEST and EU-WEST. No action needed. We expect normal service within 90 minutes and will post updates to status.redwood.ai. Reply to this thread if you need region-specific reassurance.

Alec (support): I'll add a CS FAQ entry: What to expect, how to interpret retries, and when to file a severity. Also prepping canned escalation steps for customers on Dedicated who call us mistakenly.

Lex (eng-oncall): Rollback criteria: 1) sustained 5xx rate >2% for 15m after canary, 2) p95 latency >350ms for >15m, 3) any runbook-blocking kernel panics. If triggered, we unpin runtime and divert traffic to v2.2.x + open urgent incident channel.

Hana (sre): Smoke checklist (post-maint): 1) api health checks green in both regions, 2) p50/p95 within 10% of baseline, 3) KV cache hit ratio not regressing >5%, 4) critical traces for generation path show no new exceptions.

Maya (prodops): Perfect. Alec — can you publish to statuspage + send the email at T-45? I'll coordinate the social blurb and support pin for high-commit customers.

Alec (support): Yup — publishing statuspage now to draft and will schedule email for T-45. Leaving the thread for any last-minute flags :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary starts in 30m. Notifying eng-oncall channel.
